description: The five stages of validation and their order: documents with problems in several stages, of which the validator reports those of the first stage that finds any.

cases.description: A byte-order mark before a document whose version is not supported: stage 1 reports E1003 and stops.

issues.message: The input starts with a UTF-8 byte-order mark.

cases.description: An unsupported version and an invalid registry hash: stage 2 reports E1441 and stops before the structure.

issues.message: Version '0.2.0' at /results_version is not supported. This release reads version 0.1.x.

cases.description: A statistic whose null value has no availability, in findings out of order: stage 3 reports E1402 and stops before the rules of stage 4.

issues.message: The object at /findings/0/statistics/rows lacks the required member 'availability'.

cases.description: Findings out of order, of which one has the wrong check version and one an unknown check: stage 4 reports E7002 and stops, so stage 5 does not run.

issues.message: The finding at /findings/1 is not in the order of check and scope.

cases.description: A shareable document with a person count of 4 (E7020, stage 4) and a ratio whose numerator is suppressed (E7024, stage 5): only E7020.

issues.message: The person count at /findings/1/statistics/singletons/value is below the minimum count of 10 and must be suppressed in a shareable document.

cases.description: A shareable document whose findings are out of order and write a person count of 4: the rules on findings and the invariants belong to one stage, so E7002 and E7020 are reported together, sorted by pointer.

issues.message: The person count at /findings/0/statistics/singletons/value is below the minimum count of 10 and must be suppressed in a shareable document.
The finding at /findings/1 is not in the order of check and scope.

cases.description: Another registry hash and a repeated finding of an unknown check: stage 4 reports E7001, and W7090, which stage 5 would report, does not appear.

issues.message: The finding at /findings/3 has the same check and scope as an earlier finding.
